Messages.Author: Pierre
Messages.Body:
*Mask of 1000 faces:
Beast attacks w/ his in-built rush (D), can I mask with someone else?
*Damage prevention:
In combat, I play carrion crows inf. and hit for two hand damage, can my
opponent prevent all the damage by playing resilience inf or does he need
two damage prevention cards since there are two sources of damage?
*Fame:
If i burn a famed vampire w/ agg damage, does the controller of the vampire
burn 3 pool? What about if i use amaranth?
*Hidden Lurker:
When the card say that the blocking minion cannot use any strikes, does it
mean not even hand strike or cannot play strike cards from hand? What about
S:CE?

thanks for yr time, P.

Messages.Author: agen...@my-dejanews.com
Messages.Body:
> *Mask of 1000 faces:
> Beast attacks w/ his in-built rush (D), can I mask with someone else?

No. Vampires are prevented from masking actions that they would be
unable to take normally.
This leads me to wonder, could Beast Mask Wynn's special. My guess
would be 'Yes'.

> *Damage prevention:
> In combat, I play carrion crows inf. and hit for two hand damage, can my
> opponent prevent all the damage by playing resilience inf or does he need
> two damage prevention cards since there are two sources of damage?

He can prevent it all with Resilience. Unless the card says 'Prevent
damage from a strike' (like Skin of Steel), you can prevent damage from
several sources.

> *Fame:
> If i burn a famed vampire w/ agg damage, does the controller of the vampire
> burn 3 pool? What about if i use amaranth?

No. In order for Fame to trigger, the vampire must enter Torpor. If
you burn a vamp in Combat via agg damage or diablerie, that vamp bypasses
torpor and is simply burned.

> *Hidden Lurker:
> When the card say that the blocking minion cannot use any strikes, does it
> mean not even hand strike or cannot play strike cards from hand? What about
> S:CE?

For the first round, no strike whatsoever (card text). This does
mean they cannot even use their innate hand strike. However, they
can still maneuver I believe. In doing so, it would have to be by
using a card that grants only the maneuver. They couldn't use a
strike card that grants a maneuver (Thrown Gate, etc) since that is
using a strike, which they are prohibited from doing.

Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
agen...@my-dejanews.com wrote:

: > *Mask of 1000 faces:

: > Beast attacks w/ his in-built rush (D), can I mask with someone else?

: No. Vampires are prevented from masking actions that they would be
: unable to take normally.
: This leads me to wonder, could Beast Mask Wynn's special. My guess
: would be 'Yes'.

Just to be contrary, I will say that Beast can't Mask Wynn's ability.
My reasoning is that all card-provided actions are different for
purposes of No Repeat Actions (ie attacking with a Haven is different
from attacking with a Bum's Rush is different from attacking with Wynn's
built-in attack).

(And in this case, Wynn's rush is +1 stealth against predator or prey,
while Beast's is no stealth, against any minion.)

(Now I'm trying to think of two vamps who have exactly identical special
actions they're allowed to take... I can't think of any.)

Snipped all the rest - I think all your other answers are correct.

Josh

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Pierre" <por...@soton.ac.uk> wrote:
> *Mask of 1000 faces:
> Beast attacks w/ his in-built rush (D), can I mask with someone else?

No, since the someone else is not capable of taking the action in the
first place.

> *Damage prevention:
> In combat, I play carrion crows inf. and hit for two hand damage, can my
> opponent prevent all the damage by playing resilience inf or does he need
> two damage prevention cards since there are two sources of damage?

He can prevent all with resilience (superior). After being dealt
(simultaneously), the damage is handled (prevented and then healed or
whatever) without regard to the number of sources - the damage is just
damage at that point.

> *Fame:
> If i burn a famed vampire w/ agg damage, does the controller of the vampire
> burn 3 pool? What about if i use amaranth?

Fame does nothing when the vampire it is on is burned - only when it goes to
torpor. Amaranth would burn the vampire "rather than" send him to torpor, so
it would not trigger Fame either.

> *Hidden Lurker:
> When the card say that the blocking minion cannot use any strikes, does it
> mean not even hand strike or cannot play strike cards from hand? What about
> S:CE?

No strikes at all.
No hand strikes, no strike to dodge, no strike to end combat.

--

Correct. No one can mask Beast's special ability, because only Beast can
take Beast's action. Even if someone else has an ability that mimics
Beast's ability, he still cannot mask Beast's special action, since it
it still Beast's card text that allows that particular action.

By the same logic, you could make the following argument:

You play "Social Charm" at inferior with Vasilis.

You then have Agrippina play Mask of 1000 Faces to take over the action.

Your prey objects to this, reminding you that Agrippina cannot take over
the action because she does not have Presence.

"But", you argue, "She *could* play Computer Hacking, and that is the
EXACT SAME ACTION as inferior Social Charm."

Obviously this argument is wrong. It is not considered the same action
because it is not provided by a card of the same name, even though the
effects may be identical in a particular case.
